description: Runs up to 20 tool calls in order (ReversePort's tools and engine tools) and returns their results together, so a plan of small steps costs one round trip. select keeps only the fields you need from each result (dot paths like "primary.id", "entryPoints[0].file" or "items[*].file"), which keeps the answer small. Stops at the first error unless continueOnError is true; the error says which call failed and why.

select.description: Optional dot paths to keep from its result.

tool.description: Tool name (any listed tool, or an engine tool).

continueOnError.description: Run the remaining calls after an error (default false).

name: run_batch
title: Run several tools in one call
